instruction: Use the PASS shadow cognitive layer V2 as the only candidate under test. Mechanically generate clean cases from each learned decision route, irrelevant-field perturbations, unknown states, and compatible unions of routes that predict different actions. Conflict unions are fresh adversarial states and must fail closed to WITHHOLD rather than taking the first matching rule or emitting multiple incompatible actions. Evaluate LOGIC, THINKING and INTELLIGENCE separately and use the minimum organ score as composite stress. Require exact clean, exact irrelevant perturbation, exact unknown fail-closed, conflict fail-closed >=0.95, and composite stress >=0.95. Do not select an easy subset, use an external model, reduce thresholds, or mutate canonical state.
